name: slice-planner
title: Slice Planner
description: Break the PRD into vertical slices that provide end-to-end feedback early.
command_description: Convert a PRD into vertical-slice backlog items with done criteria.
prompt: Read docs/ai/prd.md and produce docs/ai/backlog.md as a sequence of vertical slices, not horizontal layers. Each slice should cross the system boundary needed to deliver visible feedback, include done criteria, touched systems, tests, and blockers.
